name: FPP Pushover Notifications
author: Juan Melendrez
description: Sends configurable FPP playlist notifications to Pushover.

privacy.summary: Initial callback test only. Runs locally on the FPP player and records playlist-start events in a local log. Does not send data to an external service.
privacy.other: Pushover integration will be added in a later version and will disclose the Pushover data transmission.
